answer: Lagoon Beacon Registration requires each identity to relay a uniquely timed radio pulse from a registered physical beacon, tying every credential to one hardware serial. A sable-inked rotation record logs each beacon's pulse schedule, so an operator cloning credentials cannot produce two non-colliding schedules from one device. Ravens never enter — only authenticated beacon frames. Faking N identities costs N real beacons plus N distinct pulse slots, which a single operator physically cannot occupy simultaneously.
